_about: Spoken narration for the /fitness chapter "definition" (owner, 2026-10-01: "our fitness one needs this too", after hearing the MetFix Module 1 and 2 narration; amendment H.75). Its own script, not the captions: one paragraph per beat explaining what is on screen, in the order the picture builds, every sentence restating the lesson's own text (fitnessData.ts: INTRO_TEXT, DEFINITION_TEXT, POWER_CONCEPT, MODULE_COPY, SKILLS, ARCHETYPES, HOPPER_DOMAINS, ENERGY_SYSTEMS, ENERGY_BENCHMARKS, CONTINUUM_EXAMPLES) and the captions, no new facts or numbers; each beat names its passage. The voice is Charon. Edit a sentence and narration-check fails until its clip is regenerated (voice/ pipeline), copied into public/narration/fitness/definition/ and node scripts/narration-manifest.mjs has run. Plain hyphens only.

gates.why: Paragraph narration breathes between sentences (the owner-approved Charon audition pauses 0.82 s; Modules 1 and 2 measure up to 1.04 s). Every clip was generated with the 1.6 s inner-pause gate (voice/gen_chapter.py MAX_INNER), the MetFix Module 1 and 2 recipe the owner approved on 2026-10-01.

measured.text: This is the definition, built step by step. Start with power: force times distance, over time. Tell me how much weight moves, how far, and how long it takes, and you have a valid measure. One effort is one point. Then many more.

curve.text: At each effort duration, there is a highest average power you can hold, and as duration grows, that power falls: from a near 2000 watt burst, down to a few hundred watts for a marathon. And underneath, the three energy engines.

domains.source: POWER_CONCEPT s4; caption (The hopper supplies the domains); MODAL_DOMAINS
domains.text: CrossFit adds one move. The curve is different in every modal domain: weightlifting, gymnastics, cardio, odd objects, and the unknown. So average the curve across every domain. The hopper supplies the domains, and this averaged curve is the one we measure.

area.source: POWER_CONCEPT s5; DEFINITION_TEXT s1 and s3
area.text: Fitness is the area under that averaged curve. Fill it in, and the whole area is your score. It is measurable, it is observable, and it leaves no room for opinion. This is work capacity across broad time and modal domains.

synthesis.text: And now the models combine. The ten skills set the curve's height. The hopper supplies the domains you average across. And the three energy pathways are the time axis. Every model lives somewhere on this one chart.

specialist.text: Now compare a specialist, the powerlifter. Against the generalist, its curve falls short almost everywhere, and that whole region is lost. It wins just one zone: the shortest efforts. A specialist wins one point on the axis. The generalist wins the integral.

lineup.source: MODULE_COPY definition s4; POWER_CURVES ranked by area
lineup.text: Here is the whole lineup, ranked by area. The generalist comes first, then the team-sport athlete, the triathlete, the marathoner, the sprinter, the powerlifter, and the sedentary adult. A specialist owns one zone. The generalist defends the whole curve.
